advancedAnalytics.title: Advanced Analytics
advancedAnalytics.subtitle: Here are some ideas for more in-depth reports you could build.
advancedAnalytics.cardTimeEngagementDescription: Track the average time users spend on courses and specific activities. This would likely require Moodle logs or a specific plugin.
advancedAnalytics.cardAssessmentDescription: Analyze average scores, pass/fail rates, and identify difficult questions across all quizzes and assignments.
advancedAnalytics.cardPopularContentDescription: Identify which course modules, pages, or activities are viewed the most and least frequently to help optimize content.
